**actnode v0.2.0** — reusable workflows, remote scan, tag cache.

- **Reusable workflows**: `uses: org/repo/.github/workflows/x.yml@ref` (and local `./.github/workflows/…`) are fetched and scanned recursively; status `workflow` (`wfl` in text). Nested findings show `(inside …)` and are not rewritten by `--fix` (same rule as composites).
- **Remote scan**: `actnode --repo owner/name` and `actnode --org owner` list workflows via the GitHub API — no clone. Org mode scans public non-fork repos by default. Findings are labeled `owner/repo:.github/workflows/…`. `--fix` with `--repo`/`--org` errors (needs a local checkout).
- **Tag cache**: version tag lookups persist under `~/.cache/actnode` (or `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/actnode`) for 24 hours. Pass `--no-cache` to always hit the API.

Docs: https://blackman99.github.io/actnode/docs/
